badge.description: The role's badge, if it has one.

default.description: Whether every member holds this role from the moment they join.

protected.description: Whether the role is exempt from modification and deletion.

memberCount.description: Number of members holding this role.

mentionable.description: Whether @role mentions resolve to this role.

items.description: A URI within the labelled record.

labelView.description: A label applied to a record.

space.description: The channel's space, which is its identity.

viewer.description: The requesting user's access to this channel.

private.description: Whether the default role is denied channel.view in the channel, directly or through its category.

category.description: The category this channel is listed under.

linkEmbeds.description: Whether link previews are shown here.

migratedFrom.description: The legacy channel whose history is served alongside this one.

permissionOverrides.description: Per-role and per-member permission overrides set here.

channelView.description: A channel as the AppView serves it. The channel's identity is its space.

handle.description: The owner's handle, when it resolves.

legacyOwner.description: The owner of a legacy community.

isOwner.description: Whether the user holds a protected role.

isMember.description: Whether the user holds a member record.

applicationPending.description: Whether the user has an unapproved application.

viewerState.description: The requesting user's relationship to a community.

private.description: Whether the default role is denied channel.view in the category.

permissionOverrides.description: Per-role and per-member permission overrides set here.

categoryView.description: A category and the channels in it.

did.description: The community's DID, which is the authority for all of its spaces.

banner.description: URL of the community's banner, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

viewer.description: The requesting user's relationship to this community.

picture.description: URL of the community's icon, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

labelers.description: DIDs whose labels this community honours.

migration.description: When and by whom this community moved from its repo-backed predecessor. Set on migrated communities.

linkEmbeds.description: Whether link previews are shown by default.

customEmoji.description: Which custom emoji render in this community. all allows custom emoji from any source, local only the community's own emoji, none disables custom emoji. Disallowed emoji show their fallback text. Absent means all.

managingApp.description: The AppView that manages this community's spaces. When it is not the AppView that served this view, the client must talk to that AppView for this community's reads, writes, events and voice.

migratedFrom.description: The repo-backed community this one replaces, if any.

hideOwnerBadge.description: Whether the owner badge next to the community owner's name is hidden. Absent means false.

overrideUserNameColors.description: Whether only role colours are shown in chat. Members' own name colours are hidden, and a member without a coloured role shows the default name colour. Absent means false.

requiresApprovalToJoin.description: Whether joining produces an application to approve.

communityView.description: A community as the AppView serves it.

migrationInfo.description: When and by whom a community moved onto spaces.

icon.description: The icon's identifier in the client's curated set, for example shield-check.

color.description: Hex colour as #rrggbb. Absent means the role colour, or the client's default badge colour.

roleIconBadge.description: A role badge drawn from the client's curated icon set.

uses.description: How many times it has been redeemed.

active.description: Whether it can still be redeemed.

maxUses.description: How many times it may be redeemed, if limited.

expiresAt.description: When it stops being redeemable, if ever.

moderationView.description: An entry in a community's moderation log.

customEmoji.description: The record of a custom emoji.

roleEmojiBadge.description: A role badge drawn from an emoji. Exactly one of emoji and customEmoji is set.

dismissed.description: Whether a moderator has hidden this from the active queue.

applicationView.description: A pending request to join a community that requires approval.

bannedActorView.description: A member who is currently banned from a community. Derived from the moderation log, which records bans and unbans as separate entries.

step.description: The step running now. Same values as social.colibri.beta.sync.defs#communityProgressEvent.

failed.description: Whether the last attempt failed. Starting the migration again resumes it from the last finished step.

migrationProgress.description: How far a migration has come.

canPost.description: Whether the user may post in this channel.

canRead.description: Whether the user may read this channel.

permissions.description: The requesting user's effective permissions in this channel, after category and channel overrides.

channelViewerState.description: The requesting user's access to a channel.

name.description: The custom emoji's name without colons. Absent when this AppView has not indexed the emoji.

image.description: URL of the custom emoji's image, served by this AppView's blob proxy. Absent when this AppView has not indexed the emoji.

customEmoji.description: The record of a custom emoji.

roleEmojiBadgeView.description: A badge drawn from an emoji. Exactly one of emoji and customEmoji is set.

image.description: URL of the badge image, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

roleImageBadgeView.description: A badge drawn from an uploaded image.

did.description: The legacy community's DID, which becomes the authority for its spaces once migrated.

owner.description: The member who owns the legacy community, for members to ask about the move.

state.description: Where the community stands. migratable waits for an administrator, migrating is moving now, blocked cannot move. Absent means migratable.

handle.description: The community's handle, when its DID document still resolves one.

picture.description: URL of the legacy community's icon, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

progress.description: How far a running migration has come. Set while state is migrating.

memberCount.description: How many member records the legacy repo holds.

channelCount.description: How many channel records the legacy repo holds. Migration recreates one space per channel.

blockedReason.description: Why a blocked community cannot move. ownerRepo lives inside its owner's repo, unreadable has a repo that did not respond, noAdmin has nobody left who may migrate it.

viewerIsAdmin.description: Whether the requesting user may migrate this community. Only an administrator of the legacy community can.

legacyCommunityView.description: A repo-backed community that has not been migrated onto spaces yet, as read live from its own public repo. This is not an indexed view: the AppView holds nothing about a community until it is migrated.
